title: The Oath upon Mount Hermon
place: Stele of the Covenant · Threshold of Hermon
body: Two hundred Watchers descended upon the summit of Ardis on Mount Hermon and bound themselves by mutual imprecations under Semjaza. They taught the children of earth the forging of swords and breastplates of brass, the cutting of roots, and the signs of the firmament, until the cry of the perishing ascended to the gates of heaven.
note: Inspired by 1 Enoch (The Book of the Watchers, chapters 6–21). The Chasm of Dudael, these tablets, and the celestial flight trials are a theological dark-fantasy adaptation.
